name: author-site
title: Author Site
description: The site of a manga author, end to end, made only with mangacn: a header with the author's name and a breadcrumb, then three screens that lead to each other. Catalog: the works as VolumeCards (the newest one wrapped in an ObiBand), this week's releases in a ReleaseCalendar (strip of days), the most read series in a RankingList with big numbers, links to the latest chapters and a Shelf of every volume (pull one, then open its series). Series page: a SeriesHeader (cover, stamp status, genres, figures, folding summary, Start reading / Continue), the chapter list (read chapters carry a brush check, the next one shows its date) and a Spoiler hiding the next chapter's preview. Reader: Page by page with PageReader or Panel by panel with GuidedView (a pressed toggle), both fed by the same chapter written as page data (PageData: panels, drawn art, real bubbles, captions and sound effects); all pages in PageThumbnails and ReaderSettings (order, mode, fit, background) in Sheets from the toolbar, the strip mode as pages one under the other, and a ChapterEnd after the last page leading to the next chapter (or its date, or the end of the series) and back to the series. Each screen slides in; reading progress is remembered per series for Continue. Works at 375 px, in light and dark, with any accent.
docs: Import from "@/components/manga/blocks/author-site". The works, chapters and pages are data at the top of the file: replace SERIES with your series and chapterPages() with your chapters as PageData (or give PageReader and GuidedView scans). The three screens are the component's state: wire show() to your router to give each one a URL.

meta.tagline: A manga author's site: catalog, series page, then the chapter read page by page or panel by panel.
